column1: # External test corpus, fetched by scripts/fetch-corpus.sh into corpus/external/<name>.
# Every source is pinned to a commit so a fetch is reproducible; bump the commit
# deliberately, never float it. Paths are sparse-checkout patterns (space-separated,
# no spaces inside a pattern). Columns are tab-separated. pdf.js's test manifest
# carries the passwords of its encrypted files, which the corpus tests use.
